query: Which NCAA record does the quarterback of the Minnesota Vikings hold?
ground_truth: most total touchdowns in NCAA history

pipeline_result.response: Case Keenum holds the record for total passing yards, touchdowns, and completions in NCAA football.
retrieved_context: Dan LeFevour: Daniel Terrence LeFevour (born March 19, 1987) is a Canadian football quarterback for the Winnipeg Blue Bombers of the Canadian Football League (CFL).  He was drafted by the Chicago Bears in the sixth round of the 2010 NFL Draft.  He played college football at Central Michigan University.  Known as a dual-threat quarterback, LeFevour had the most total touchdowns in NCAA history until being surpassed by Case Keenum in 2011.

Case Keenum: Casey Austin Keenum (born February 17, 1988) is an American football quarterback for the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League (NFL).  He played college football for Houston, where he became the NCAA's all-time leader in total passing yards, touchdowns, and completions.  He was signed by the Houston Texans as an undrafted free agent in 2012, and has also played for the St. Louis/Los Angeles Rams.
